oneLiner: Shift scheduling by text message for teams that work in shifts across more than one site. When someone calls out, it finds a qualified replacement for you.
valuePoints: When someone calls out, Crewbeam texts qualified, available people in order until the shift is covered. No phone tree.
Flags overtime before it happens, while there is still time to move a shift.
Works by text message, so crews don't need to install an app.
Managers see open shifts across every site on one screen.
priceHint: About $6 per scheduled employee per month. No setup fee.

oneLiner: Automatic invoice and balance reminders with pay-by-text, so money comes in sooner and nobody has to make the awkward call.
valuePoints: Sends polite, scheduled reminders by text and email until a balance is paid.
Customers pay from a link in the text, by card or bank transfer.
Payments post back to your accounting or practice software automatically.
Shows you who owes what and how old each balance is, on one screen.
priceHint: Starts at $249 per month plus standard card processing fees.

oneLiner: A secure portal for collecting and signing documents, so paperwork arrives complete and doesn't travel as email attachments.
valuePoints: Clients upload documents to an encrypted portal, not email.
Checklists show what is still missing and send reminders until it arrives.
E-signatures, with a full audit trail of who opened, uploaded, and signed what.
Branded with your logo, so clients trust the link.
priceHint: About $40 per staff user per month. Clients never pay.
